why: The churchyard read busy: the yard paintings carried their own flowerbeds, headstones and dense foliage, and every planting and statue arrived ornate (ivy, gold trim, its own mound of dirt and stones). This set repaints all three as ONE calm hand: open lawns with nothing on them, and plain objects with clean silhouettes that stand on the grass rather than on a patch of their own. Same paths as the owner's 2026-10-21 set, so ownerArt.ts and sceneArt.ts need no change.
scene_model: fal-ai/flux-pro/kontext: an EDIT of the owner's 2026-10-21 painting at the same path

prop_style: ONE object centred on a SOLID FLAT MAGENTA (#FF00FF) background. Soft painted gouache illustration, muted warm natural colours, gentle top-left light, a clean simple silhouette, very little fine detail. The whole object visible, standing upright, seen from the front at eye level. NO ivy, NO vines, NO gold trim, NO ornament, NO mound of soil, NO rocks or pebbles around the base, NO grass patch, NO ground, NO cast shadow, no text, no frame.

buildings_note: Kontext edits OF the owner's six buildings: the architecture is kept, the painting is simplified to this hand, and the patch of ground, shrubs and flowers around each base is removed so the building stands on the yard's own grass.
scene_edit: Simplify this painting into a calm, uncluttered, EMPTY churchyard lawn. Keep EXACTLY the same painterly style, warm golden light, colours, camera angle and horizon height. REMOVE every flower, flowerbed, wildflower, headstone, grave marker, standing stone, path, stepping stone, puddle, rock and bush from the lawn and the foreground, and replace them with smooth, evenly mown grass. Keep the trees only at the far left and far right edges and the soft treeline along the horizon; keep the middle of the horizon open. No buildings, no people, no text.
ladder_note: 32 buildings, 8 tiers x 4 skins, at public/church/buildings/<skin>-<tier>.png. Tier 1 of each skin is drawn from text; every later tier is a Kontext EDIT of the tier below it ('grow this building into ...'), so a church visibly grows rather than being replaced, and the four skins share each tier's shape while differing in material. Replaces the owner's six, which drew levels 8-26 as one building and both stone ladders as tile AND classic.
ladder_style: ONE church building centred on a SOLID FLAT MAGENTA (#FF00FF) background, seen from the front at a slight angle, whole building visible. Soft hand-painted gouache storybook illustration, warm late-afternoon light from the top left, clean readable silhouette that still reads at thumbnail size, warm windows faintly lit from inside. NO ground, NO grass, NO shrubs, NO flowers, NO path, NO people, NO shadow, no text, no frame.

skins_material.glass: pale grey limestone walls, dark grey lead roofs, and LARGE tall pointed stained-glass windows glowing brightly from inside in jewel colours (ruby, sapphire, emerald, gold) that are the most noticeable thing about the building; NO chimneys, NO flowers

scene_note: 2026-11-12, second pass: the yards are now painted FROM TEXT in the buildings' own hand (same model and style words as ladder_style), not decluttered edits of the owner's set, so the church and the ground it stands on read as one picture. Drawn square with the horizon at the middle, then cropped to 1168x784 so the horizon lands where ChurchScene's GROUND expects it (about 62% down). Flux paints what a prompt names, including what it is told to leave out, so the style lists only what IS in the picture.
scene_text_style: Soft hand-painted gouache storybook illustration, the same hand as a children's picture book: simple clean shapes, gentle painterly texture, warm golden-hour light from the top left, a soft honey-gold sky fading to pale apricot near the horizon, grass in warm olive and sage greens. A wide landscape that contains ONLY these things: the sky, a soft distant treeline and low hills along a horizon that runs exactly across the middle of the image, one tree standing at the very left edge and one at the very right edge, and a wide, open, smooth, evenly mown lawn that fills the entire lower half of the picture. The middle of the picture is open lawn and open sky. Empty and peaceful, nothing else in the scene.
